label: preparing
what: A coordinated community supper and service acknowledgement in the great hall at eighteen, presented to me as a lighting inspection. Builder is organising access and arranging my escort; innkeeper is bringing bread, with baker and freight coordinating delivery. Neighbour knowingly collects donations and escorts me while leaving acknowledgement details to organisers; secretary maintains the inspection appointment and will accompany me. The precise acknowledgement and its recipient remain undisclosed, possibly a surprise for me.
